question: Who among the following Mughal emperors assumed the title Alamgir, World Conqueror?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aurangzeb**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aurangzeb** was the sixth Mughal emperor who ruled from** 1658 to 1707**.
 
• He assumed the title Alamgir, which means World Conqueror after he ascended the throne.
 
• Aurangzeb was known for his strict policies and religious orthodoxy, which led to the decline of the Mughal Empire.
 
• He was also involved in many wars and conquests during his reign, including the Mughal-Maratha Wars and the annexation of the Bijapur Sultanate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Akbar** was one of the greatest Mughal emperors who ruled from 1556 to 1605. He was known for his religious tolerance, administrative reforms, and patronage of the arts.
 
• **Babur **was the founder of the Mughal Empire who ruled from 1526 to 1530. He was known for his military conquests and his autobiography, the Baburnama.
 
• **Shah Jahan **was the fifth Mughal emperor who ruled from 1628 to 1658. He is known for commissioning the construction of the Taj Mahal and other architectural wonders.
